Foreman administrators manage hosts, organizations, locations, and provisioning workflows. Personal access tokens provide API access without an interactive password. articles.author: NevilleChristensen2637
articles.description:
TL;DR: A password reset email is delayed because several independently queued systems must accept, process, and deliver it. Treat the message as an asynchronous security event: record when the request was accepted, when an SMTP handoff succeeded or failed, and when the reset token expires. For an edtech system that also emails a generated student report, retain those events separately from the report itself. The least complex design is a durable job record, a bounded retry policy, and an audit record that can explain the timeline without retaining more student data than the investigation requires.
The visible action is one click. The operational bill is a chain of retained artifacts: the reset request, the queued delivery job, SMTP responses, retry attempts, suppression decisions, and the …
